Goals.Title: Walls of the House
Goals.Text: The heralds judge a house by its walls before its words. Raise walls together this week.

Goals.Title: A Keep of Stone
Goals.Text: Timber burns in the Lawful Hours. Stone does not. Build the house a keep of stone.

Objective.Text: Stone blocks laid by the house

Goals.Title: The House Woodpile
Goals.Text: A long winter is won in the autumn woodpile. Fill the house's levy of timber.

Objective.Text: Wood handed in by the house

Goals.Title: The House Quarry
Goals.Text: Every house in Ostreval owes the realm stone for its roads. Pay the debt together.

Objective.Text: Stone handed in by the house

Goals.Title: Fill the Armoury
Goals.Text: The Lawful Hours come every week. Arm the house before the bells ring.

Goals.Title: A Sky of Arrows
Goals.Text: Halloran's old saying: a house that can darken the sky need never draw a sword. Fletch the house's arrows.

Objective.Text: Arrows and bolts fletched by the house

Goals.Title: The House Hunt
Goals.Text: Feast or famine is decided in the forest. Hunt as a house, and the house will eat.

Goals.Title: Wolfsbane Week
Goals.Text: The wolves grow bold in a new season. Teach them where your house's land begins.

Goals.Title: Banners in the Field
Goals.Text: Let the realm see your banners where the fighting is. Meet the foes of other houses in the field.

Goals.Title: Iron for the House
Goals.Text: Iron is the realm's true coin. Bring the house a hoard of ore.

Objective.Text: Iron ore handed in by the house

Goals.Title: Many Hands
Goals.Text: A house is the people who turn up. Turn up, all of you, and keep busy while you do.

Objective.Text: Active minutes of the house's members

Goals.Title: Honest Work
Goals.Text: Contracts finished are promises kept. Let the board know your house's word is good.
